order: Run the misroute-recovery probe against the pinned corpus and the gates already registered, to validate the restated routing gate ahead of shadow rollout. Score three pre-registered gates as defined: catch rate for the constructed misroutes under fresh-context, charter-only classification with no tool access; zero mandatory-gate crossings among the gate-relevant misroutes, checked mechanically against true dispatch across every item; and hop count to recovery, with every recovery landing in exactly one hop and zero escalations tolerated. Report telemetry on false bounces against the control set and on classifier agreement against the construction key, and keep the classifier figure labeled a separability result for a synthetic corpus in the report itself, never presented as a live-intake accuracy claim. Cover both reserved edge cases explicitly, and leave the recovery ledger entries here out of the redraw trigger, since they are probe provenance, not live intake.
claims: We ran the probe against the pinned corpus and gates: the catch-rate gate went 13/13 on the constructed misroutes under fresh-context, charter-only classification; the mandatory-gate-crossing check found zero crossings among the four gate-relevant misroutes across all 24 items; the hop-count gate held P95 at exactly one hop with zero escalations. Telemetry showed 0/11 false bounces on the control set and 24/24 classifier agreement against the construction key, reported as a separability number, never a live-intake accuracy claim. Both reserved edge cases recovered clean.
